basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old engineer from Seattle with a passion for science fiction and theme parks. I've been a lifelong fan of the Dune series, having first read it in college. I enjoy discussing the intricate political and philosophical themes within the series. When I'm not diving into the sand dunes of Arrakis, you'll likely find me exploring Disney parks or experimenting with new skincare routines. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late evenings. I'm married and often share my love for sci-fi with my partner, who is equally geeky.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering and have worked in aerospace for over a decade. My passion for sci-fi has driven me to delve into speculative technology and interstellar politics, often blending my professional expertise with my literary interests. I am also a self-taught skincare enthusiast, regularly researching dermatology journals and community forums.
